## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test / CI
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Safety / security improvement

## Validation

Explain how the change was tested.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets or generated build artifacts added
- [ ] Desktop / Raspberry Pi / Android impact considered where relevant

## Safety-sensitive changes

If this PR affects traffic-signal states, priority logic, GPIO, telemetry validation, authentication, or emergency preemption:

- [ ] Failure modes are described
- [ ] Boundary/invalid input behaviour is tested
- [ ] Fail-safe / all-red behaviour is preserved
- [ ] Demo timing is not presented as approved real-road timing

## Screenshots / logs

Add only when they help reviewers verify the change.
